responsibility: This header declares the API for gfortran’s target-memory simulation layer. It exposes size queries, byte-encoding and byte-interpretation routines for constant expressions and character data, initializer-merging support for EQUIVALENCE/COMMON handling, and BOZ reinterpretation helpers used by front-end constant evaluation and lowering.
same_name_distinction: Declares the target-memory API used by the front end—size queries, encode/interpret entry points, initializer merging, and BOZ conversion hooks. Unlike gcc/fortran/target-memory.cc, it does not perform layout simulation itself; it exposes the interface to that implementation.
